parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels forming the sides, top, bottom, and back.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and stability for the entire cabinet, holding the doors and shelves in place.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports other components.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A front door panel made of MDF, attached to the frame with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the storage space inside the cabinet when opened.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A lower front door panel made of MDF, attached to the frame with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It covers and provides access to the lower storage compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A middle door panel made of MDF, part of the cabinet’s front access system.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the middle section of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: An upper door panel made of MDF, attached to the frame with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It covers and provides access to the upper storage compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: An internal horizontal shelf made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable vertically but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A middle shelf made of particle board, supporting stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the cabinet space and holds objects.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable vertically but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A lower shelf made of particle board, part of the internal structure.
parts.Functional_description: It supports items stored in the lower section of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable vertically but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The bottom shelf of the cabinet made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the base for storing heavier items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.
